about: The evangelium of the formulary “Commemoration of the Baptism of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time John saw Jesus coming unto him and said: Behold the Lamb of God, behold Him Who taketh away the sin of the world. This is He of Whom I said: After me cometh a Man Who is made before me, because He was before me. I knew Him not, but that He might be made manifest in Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water. John bore witness also, saying: I saw the Spirit descending as a dove from heaven, and He remained upon Him. I knew Him not; but He Who sent me to baptize with water said unto me: He upon Whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending and remaining, He it is Who baptizeth with the Holy Ghost. And I saw and bore witness that this is the Son of God.
